setup: Open the app and configure its spaces/accounts through the SilverBullet dashboard.
Legacy single-space deployments can use the SB_USER setting.
integration_notes: Filesystem watch mode supports local disks or polling on network mounts.
limitations: Single-space credentials and API tokens do not create multi-space accounts.
Multi-space OIDC is configured in SilverBullet; Selfhost does not yet automate that configuration.
